title: Family protection
keywords: coverage life insurance product benefits protection

answers.en-PH: The fictional Harbor Life plan provides life cover. Benefits and exclusions depend on the issued policy; this demo does not quote a coverage amount.
answers.fil-PH: Ang demo Harbor Life ay life insurance. Nasa issued policy ang benefits at exclusions; wala akong verified coverage amount dito.

title: Initial qualification
keywords: eligible eligibility qualify qualification age resident screening

answers.en-PH: For this fictional demo, initial screening requires age 18–60, Philippine residency, and permission for an adviser callback. Screening is not approval or a quotation.
answers.fil-PH: Sa demo na ito, paunang screening lang: edad 18–60, residente ng Pilipinas, at pahintulot para sa adviser callback. Hindi ito approval o quotation.

title: Premium and payment
keywords: premium payment monthly cost presyo bayad magkano

answers.en-PH: A premium is the amount paid to keep a policy in force, subject to its terms. This demo has no verified premium schedule. An adviser must confirm a quote; do not send money through this demo.
answers.fil-PH: Ang premium ang bayad para manatiling active ang policy, ayon sa terms nito. Wala tayong verified premium schedule. Adviser ang magkukumpirma ng quote; huwag magpadala ng pera sa demo.

title: Missed premium
keywords: lapse grace missed late premium renewal renew

answers.en-PH: Missing a premium may affect coverage. The actual policy determines any grace period or lapse. No grace-period length is approved in this demo; request adviser assistance.
answers.fil-PH: Kapag na-miss ang premium, maaaring maapektuhan ang coverage. Depende sa policy ang grace period at lapse. Walang approved na bilang ng araw sa demo; adviser po ang magkukumpirma.

title: Budget concern
keywords: expensive afford budget mahal costly gastos

answers.en-PH: If the premium feels expensive, offer an adviser callback to discuss the customer’s budget. Do not invent a discount, reduce cover without consent, or promise acceptance.
answers.fil-PH: Kung mabigat sa budget ang premium, puwedeng magpa-callback sa adviser para mapag-usapan ang budget. Walang ipinapangakong discount o approval.

title: Beneficiary and rider
keywords: beneficiary rider dependents anak family add on

answers.en-PH: A beneficiary is the person designated to receive a covered benefit, subject to policy terms. A rider is an optional additional benefit; availability and cost require adviser confirmation.
answers.fil-PH: Ang beneficiary ang itinalagang tatanggap ng covered benefit, ayon sa policy. Ang rider ay optional na dagdag na benefit; ipa-confirm sa adviser ang availability at cost.

title: Bank referral
keywords: bank referral bancassurance deposit guaranteed investment returns

answers.en-PH: A bank referral connects the customer to an insurance adviser. This fictional product is insurance, not a bank deposit. Do not promise guaranteed investment returns.
answers.fil-PH: Ang bank referral ay pagpapakilala sa insurance adviser. Insurance ito, hindi bank deposit. Hindi kami nangangako ng guaranteed investment returns.

title: Adviser callback
keywords: callback adviser human tao agent assistance

answers.en-PH: A callback request in this demo creates a local mock CRM record only. No adviser is actually contacted. Confirm the preferred time and consent before recording a request.
answers.fil-PH: Local mock CRM record lang ang callback request sa demo. Wala pang totoong adviser na makokontak. Kailangan muna ang pahintulot at preferred na oras.

title: Consumer financing
keywords: pembiayaan product finance consumer motor vehicle

answers.id-ID: Demo Nusantara Finance adalah simulasi pembiayaan konsumen. Persetujuan, nilai pembiayaan, dan syarat harus diverifikasi petugas; ini bukan penawaran kredit.

title: Installment and due date
keywords: cicilan angsuran jatuh tempo payment bayar installment tanggal

answers.id-ID: Cicilan atau angsuran dibayar sesuai jadwal dalam kontrak. Tanggal jatuh tempo dan jumlah tagihan belum tersedia di demo ini. Cek kanal resmi pada kontrak atau minta bantuan petugas; jangan transfer lewat demo.

title: Late payment charges
keywords: denda late penalty terlambat telat biaya

answers.id-ID: Denda mengikuti kontrak pembiayaan yang berlaku. Demo ini tidak memiliki tarif denda terverifikasi. Saya bisa mencatat permintaan bantuan petugas, tanpa menjanjikan penghapusan denda.

title: Payment difficulty
keywords: susah belum gajian sulit afford difficulty nggak bisa bayar gak bisa bayar berat

answers.id-ID: Saya paham, Bapak/Ibu sedang kesulitan membayar. Saya bisa mencatat permintaan untuk membahas pilihan bantuan dengan petugas. Tidak ada janji penundaan, restrukturisasi, atau penghapusan denda.

title: Tenor and down payment
keywords: tenor dp down payment uang muka term

answers.id-ID: Tenor adalah jangka waktu pembiayaan, sedangkan DP adalah uang muka. Besaran DP dan pilihan tenor harus diperiksa dalam penawaran resmi; demo ini tidak menetapkan angka.

title: Officer callback
keywords: callback petugas manusia hubungi bantuan telepon

answers.id-ID: Permintaan callback hanya disimpan sebagai catatan CRM lokal untuk demo. Belum ada petugas yang dihubungi. Mohon konfirmasi persetujuan dan waktu yang diinginkan.

title: Initial screening
keywords: eligible eligibility qualification usia umur domisili

answers.id-ID: Demo ini hanya mengumpulkan minat dan persetujuan callback. Kelayakan pembiayaan harus diperiksa petugas berdasarkan dokumen dan kebijakan resmi; jangan kirim NIK atau nomor rekening.
